column1: # Per-user service instances, the _xxxxx suffixed ones, are folded into their base name.
# Start is the decimal start type: 0 boot, 1 system, 2 automatic, 3 manual, 4 disabled.

# Overrides are Build:Value and replace Start on that build only. Build/EditionID:Value applies only where HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion EditionID matches, and wins over Build:Value.
# Managed is 1 for a service XOS touches and 0 for reference data. Only managed rows are restored.
# Category is raw for a straight Start write, defender for the full Defender workflow, empty for reference.

# Delayed is * or a comma list of builds where Windows ships the service as automatic (delayed start), DelayedAutostart=1. It applies only where Start resolves to 2. It is maintained for managed rows only, the ones the Toolkit restores; reference rows leave it empty even where Windows starts the service delayed (CDPSvc, DispBrokerDesktopSvc, edgeupdate, OneSyncSvc, sppsvc, StorSvc, whesvc, W32Time on some builds). Measured on clean Windows installs.
